dateline: BTS closed a sold-out three-night Lima run (~151,500 fans, Oct 7/9/10) at Estadio San Marcos; Santiago (Oct 14, 16, 17) is next.
heroHeadline: Day 4,872: Lima Closes at ~151,500 Fans, Santiago Next
heroSubtitle: October 15, 2026 is Day 4,872 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. The ARIRANG World Tour finished a sold-out three-night Lima run — the group's first visit to Peru — and moves to Santiago's Estadio Nacional.
